add_to_cart.contents: Definite path: clicking 'Pre-Order' while signed in slides the checkout drawer in from the right over the dimmed, blurred page (about 40% of the viewport wide, white, round outlined 'X' close button top-right). The drawer is the checkout.playstation.com web-checkout client in a cross-origin iframe (observed signed out: it shows the client's /login view, heading 'Sign in to proceed' rendered in title case as 'Sign In To Proceed', plus a blue 'Sign In' pill). Because the Pre-Order CTA's action is BUY_NOW (page data), the signed-in drawer opens on the client's /buynow/{sku} view rather than on a cart: header 'Confirm Pre-Order' (the client's HEADER_CONFIRM_PREORDER string; a non-pre-order Buy Now shows 'Confirm Purchase'), then the item tile (80x80 cover art, 'Grand Theft Auto VI' / 'Grand Theft Auto VI: Ultimate Edition', ESRB rating image, pre-order dates such as 'Release Date: 11/18/2026' / 'Expected download date: ...'), price, the 'Payment method' section (hosted transact.playstation.com iframe showing the default instrument, wallet funds and a change/add control), an optional 'Redeem Code' discount box ('Enter discount code' + 'Apply'; present in the bundle, rendering not verified for US digital carts), the summary rows 'Subtotal' / 'Tax' / 'Total (1 item)', the pre-order legal line, and the orange 'Pre-Order & Pay' button, with a 'Learn more about taxes and fees' link (US only) and 'Continue Shopping'. Labels come from the client's English msgid table and route/chunk code (not seen rendered signed in). The header 'Cart' icon opens the same drawer on the cart view instead ('Cart (1 Item)' / 'Cart (N Items)'), which has the same payment + summary + confirm layout and also no separate 'Checkout' step. Official web wording remains only 'Select Add to Cart (or Pre-Order) and then follow the on-screen instructions to complete your purchase.'

cart.url: Drawer, not a page: the header 'Cart' button opens the checkout.playstation.com client on its cart view ('/' route, document title 'Cart | Checkout') inside a right-side panel; the store URL does not change. A store route also exists: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/cart redirects (observed) to https://store.playstation.com/en-us/pages/cart/ ; signed out that page renders the store's fallback (heading 'This probably isn't what you're looking for...' with 'Back to Store or Home.' links). The client's /unified/cart route (header 'Continue to Checkout') is the one-commerce cart for PS Direct hardware; the digital store session has isUnifiedCart=false, so it is not used here.

Payment-method section is the hosted transact.playstation.com iframe: shows the default instrument (e.g. 'Card ending in %num%'), 'Wallet Balance' / 'Wallet funds', and 'Change Payment Method' > 'Please select a payment method.' with a 'Default' tag and 'Add Payment Method'; official rule: 'your wallet funds are used first' and any shortfall is settled with the selected payment method

checkout.url: Right-side drawer (cross-origin iframe) served from https://checkout.playstation.com and shown on top of the store page; the store URL does not change. Client routes seen in its build manifest: /buynow/[sku] (what the Pre-Order CTA opens; page id BUY_NOW), / (cart view, page id PURCHASE, title 'Cart | Checkout'), /login ('Sign in to proceed'), /thankyou ('Thank You | Checkout'), /error ('Error | Checkout'), /transaction-history, /post-purchase/order-history, /unified/* (PS Direct one-commerce). Observed: loading https://checkout.playstation.com/ or /cart directly (no store session) redirects to https://checkout.playstation.com/error?cartAction=%2Ferror — a bare white page titled 'Error | Checkout' with the heading 'Something went wrong.' and a single 'Close' button. The payment-method and add-card screens inside the drawer are a second hosted iframe from https://transact.playstation.com (Sony's 'transact' app, strings at /i18n/en-us.json).

auth.screen_text: Sony/PlayStation sign-in page: the store's header 'Sign In' pill, the drawer's 'Sign In' button and the signed-out 'Pre-Order' click all go to https://web.np.playstation.com/api/session/v1/signin?redirect_uri=<store url> (web-toolbar config; sets the isSignedIn cookie on return), which forwards to my.account.sony.com/central/signin/ with a return URL. Per Sony's account help (basic300): headline 'Sign In'; step 1 field 'Sign-in ID (Email address)' with 'Next'; step 2 'Password' with 'Sign In'; optional 'Sign in with Passkey'; if 2-step verification is on, a 'confirmation code' field with 'Verify' (or a backup code); links 'Trouble Signing In?', 'reset your password', 'create a new account' (PlayStation help labels it 'Create New Account'). No guest option. The page itself was not observed: the sandbox browser refuses my.account.sony.com and the session sign-in endpoint, and WebFetch is blocked for that domain, so exact casing/layout is unverified (confidence medium). Observed instead: the signed-out drawer shows the client's /login view — heading 'Sign in to proceed' (displayed as 'Sign In To Proceed') and a blue 'Sign In' pill — and the store header has a blue 'Sign In' pill.
signin_fields: Confirmation code (only if 2-step verification is enabled)

Two-step Sony account sign-in ('Sign In' headline; email > Next; password > Sign In; optional passkey; optional 2-step verification code > Verify). Returns to the store page after success, where the header shows the avatar and the 'Cart' icon. Labels from Sony's account help; the page was not observed (confidence medium).

PayPal / Venmo / Apple Pay / Cash App Pay (1 payment service saved per account)

steps.notes: Inside the same right-side drawer, all on one panel: header 'Confirm Pre-Order' (the client uses HEADER_CONFIRM_PREORDER when the buy-now item is a pre-order; a plain item says 'Confirm Purchase'); item tile with cover art, 'Grand Theft Auto VI' (or ': Ultimate Edition'), rating image and pre-order dates; 'Payment method' (hosted transact iframe; default instrument preselected; wallet funds are used first and any shortfall goes to the selected card/service, official); summary rows 'Subtotal', 'Tax' (sales tax from the account's US address; the client inserts the Tax row for tax-exclusive countries like the US), optional 'Discount', 'Total (1 item)'; then the legal line and the button. Button label logic in the client: 'Processing...' while submitting; otherwise 'Pre-Order & Pay' when the cart/buy-now contains a pre-order (US), 'Order & Pay' in SCEE/LatAm for regular items, 'Confirm Purchase' for regular US items and Brazil. US pre-order legal line (verbatim from the client): 'You'll be charged for your pre-order when you select [Pre-Order & Pay]. If the price drops before the product is released, we'll refund you the difference. When you select [Pre-Order & Pay], you agree the purchase is governed by the PlayStation Terms of Service. You also acknowledge that your purchase of any digital content amounts to a license, subject to the PlayStation End User License Agreement.' Regular US digital items instead get 'By selecting [Confirm Purchase], you agree to complete the purchase in accordance with the PlayStation Terms of Service before using this content. You also acknowledge ... End User License Agreement.' If 'Require Password at Checkout' is on, a 'Password' prompt ('Enter your password'; error 'Incorrect password') appears above the button and the drawer notes '[Require Password at Checkout] setting is turned on.' Extras: 'Learn more about taxes and fees' link (US), PlayStation Visa promo strip, 'Continue Shopping'. Source: the live checkout client's route/chunk code and msgid table (not seen rendered signed in; confidence medium-high for labels, medium for layout order).

CVV ('This is the 3- or 4-digit code on your credit/debit card.')

options: Add Payment Method > Add a Credit/Debit Card ('Add your payment method (maximum 3 credit/debit cards).')
steps.notes: Official (PlayStation Support, 'How to use credit or debit cards on PlayStation Store'): 'Select Add Payment Method > Add a Credit/Debit Card. Enter your card information and select Next. Enter your billing address and select Save.' The screens are rendered by Sony's hosted 'transact' iframe (transact.playstation.com); its English string file (/i18n/en-us.json) and compiled add-card template give the labels: screen 'Add a Credit/Debit Card'; card form 'Credit/Debit Card Number' (card type auto-detected, fallback '- Select credit/debit card type -'), 'Cardholder's Name', expiry 'Month' / 'Year' selects ('Expires On'), 'CVV' with helper 'This is the 3- or 4-digit code on your credit/debit card.'; billing screen 'Billing Information' with 'First name', 'Last name', 'Street address', 'Address 2 (optional)', 'City', 'State' (or 'State or province'), 'ZIP Code' (also 'Postal Code' in the newer template), 'Country or region', 'Phone number'; buttons 'Next' / 'Save' / 'Back' / 'Cancel'; success 'Credit/debit card has been successfully added.' / 'Your credit/debit card has been saved.'; 'Set as Default Payment Method' and the note 'Your default payment method is used to complete your purchase when your wallet doesn't have enough funds.' Maximum 3 cards ('You have reached the maximum of three credit/debit cards on file.'). The string file also carries a newer label set ('Card number', 'Expiration date', 'CVV number', 'Cardholder's name'), so exact casing may differ by screen version; the form was not seen rendered (confidence medium).

steps.name: Confirmation ('Thank You | Checkout')
options: Download from Library (primary button, opens library.playstation.com)
steps.notes: The drawer's /thankyou view (document title 'Thank You | Checkout'): H2 'Thank you for your purchase!' with the buyer's Online ID on the line below; the purchased item tile (cover art) with, for pre-orders, 'This game will be released on %date%.' (single item) or 'Releases on: %date%'; a download hint box headed 'Download to Console' with 'Start downloading to your console from your game library.' (mobile: 'Start Downloading' / 'Select Library in PlayStation App, and then select the game you want to download to your console.'); buttons 'Download from Library' (primary) and 'Continue Shopping'; legal footer. No order number is shown on this screen (the client's thank-you code has no order-number strings; 'ORDER NUMBER' appears only on the one-commerce order-confirmation/order-history pages used for PS Direct hardware). Purchase is charged immediately — official: 'You are charged and the pre-order appears in your Library, PlayStation Store, and PlayStation App.' Receipt email is sent to the sign-in ID email. Remote download afterwards (official): avatar > Game Library > Purchased > select the game > Download. Source: the live client's thank-you chunk and msgid table (not observed rendered; confidence medium-high).

quirks: Digital-only storefront: no shipping, pickup, quantity or physical/code-in-box options; the license is tied to the PSN account used to buy.
A PSN (Sony) account is mandatory — no guest checkout. Both 'Pre-Order' and 'Add to Wishlist' send signed-out shoppers to Sony's sign-in domain (my.account.sony.com) and back.

Two page types: /concept/{id}/ (edition-agnostic, shows the featured edition — currently the Ultimate Edition — plus an 'Editions:' comparison section) and /product/{productId} per edition. Both look identical apart from the headline and price.
Editions are 'separate listings' on one page: each edition card carries its own price and its own Pre-Order button; there is no dropdown.
Release is displayed as an unlock timestamp '11/18/2026 09:00 PM PST' (midnight Eastern on Nov 19) and edition cards advertise '7-Day Pre-load'.
You are charged immediately when you confirm the pre-order; cancellation is by contacting PlayStation Support (no self-serve cancel button), subject to the 14-day / pre-load rules.

Checkout is an overlay from a separate domain (checkout.playstation.com) rather than a page, and the payment-method/add-card screens inside it are a second hosted iframe (transact.playstation.com); sales tax is added there as a 'Tax' row based on the account address.
Wallet-first payment model: purchases can be funded from PSN wallet balance (topped up by cards, payment services or gift-card codes); any shortfall goes to the selected card/service.
GTA+ pre-order bonus is not auto-applied — the shopper must visit the GTA+ product page after purchase and 'follow the on-screen instructions' to claim the free month, which then auto-renews.
ESRB rating is 'RP' (Rating Pending) with 'May contain content inappropriate for children'; there is no age gate on the page.
The 'Ultimate Edition Upgrade' add-on is listed but 'Unavailable' until launch.
OneTrust cookie 'Privacy Preference Center' is present on every page (was collapsed in the sandbox).

Header search is an expanding field ('Search PS Store' placeholder, 'Cancel search' control) that navigates to /en-us/search/{q}; results are a 6-up tile grid with a 'Filter' button and numbered pagination.

Light chrome / dark product area: white header and search pages, but the product hero, edition cards and add-on tiles use a dark (#1F2024 / #121314) theme with white text and an orange (#D63D00) pill CTA; footer is PlayStation blue (#003697).

Cart is a right-hand drawer, not a page: the header 'Cart' button (present in the global header even when signed out) slides a white panel over the dimmed page; signed out it shows the drawer's login view 'Sign in to proceed' (displayed 'Sign In To Proceed') with a blue 'Sign In' pill; signed in it shows 'Cart (N Items)'. /en-us/cart redirects to /en-us/pages/cart/, which signed out shows the store's 'This probably isn't what you're looking for...' fallback.
The drawer's content is the checkout.playstation.com client in a cross-origin iframe; hitting that domain directly gives a bare 'Error | Checkout' page ('Something went wrong.' + 'Close').

Signed out, 'Pre-Order' does not open the drawer — it redirects to Sony sign-in; only the 'Cart' icon opens the drawer. Signed in, the Pre-Order CTA is a BUY_NOW action, so the drawer opens straight on a 'Confirm Pre-Order' view for that SKU (item + payment method + Subtotal/Tax/Total + 'Pre-Order & Pay'); there is no cart step and no 'Checkout' button.
Optional account setting 'Require Password at Checkout' inserts a password prompt before every purchase (not when funding the wallet).
Signed-in header shows an avatar whose menu includes Game Library > Purchased (with 'Download') and Payment Management (wallet balance at the top, 'Add Funds').

The confirm button is not 'Confirm Purchase' for this title: because the item is a pre-order the client labels it 'Pre-Order & Pay' (US), with the legal line 'You'll be charged for your pre-order when you select [Pre-Order & Pay]. If the price drops before the product is released, we'll refund you the difference.' ('Confirm Purchase' is used for regular digital items.)

The on-screen confirmation ('Thank you for your purchase!' + Online ID, 'Download from Library', 'Continue Shopping') shows no order number; the order number only appears in the receipt email / Transaction History.
